title_en: Supreme People's Court Issues Notice Requiring Severe Punishment of Criminals Who Hunt and Kill Giant Pandas, Traffick in or Smuggle Giant Panda Skins
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Issues Notice Requiring Severe Punishment According to Law of Criminals Who Hunt and Kill Giant Pandas, or Traffic or Smuggle Giant Panda Skins

In recent years, some criminals, in pursuit of exorbitant profits, have resorted to various illegal means to hunt and kill giant pandas, traffic giant panda skins, and collude with overseas criminals to smuggle them, causing extremely serious harm. In order to protect giant pandas, the Supreme People's Court recently issued a notice to the Higher People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government, as well as to the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army, requiring severe punishment according to law of criminals who hunt and kill giant pandas, or traffic or smuggle giant panda skins.

The notice provides the following interpretations on the application of law to criminals who hunt and kill giant pandas, or traffic or smuggle giant panda skins:

1. For those who hunt and kill giant pandas and sell the skins, they shall be sentenced severely in accordance with Articles 117 and 118 of the Criminal Law, and Item (1) of Article 1 of the Decision of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress on Severely Punishing Criminals Who Seriously Sabotage the Economy.

2. For those who smuggle giant panda skins, they shall be sentenced severely in accordance with Articles 116 and 118 of the Criminal Law, and Item (1) of Article 1 of the Decision of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress on Severely Punishing Criminals Who Seriously Sabotage the Economy.

3. The giant panda is an extremely precious and rare wild animal. Trafficking or smuggling a single giant panda skin shall be deemed as a case of especially serious circumstances, and in accordance with Item (1) of Article 1 of the Decision of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress on Severely Punishing Criminals Who Seriously Sabotage the Economy, the sentence shall be fixed-term imprisonment of not less than ten years, life imprisonment, or the death penalty, and may also be sentenced to confiscation of property.

Those who instigate others to hunt and kill giant pandas, or to traffic or smuggle giant panda skins, shall be severely punished as instigators.
